g.text: Illustrative Sonnet 5.5 API-equivalent costs • 100k cached tokens → 20k generated summary

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #242629

g.text: Both preserve cache benefits after the first continuation. Compaction pays once to make future reads smaller.
Assumptions: fixed reusable context; 20k summary output; one-hour cache writes; full cache hits thereafter.
Common new messages, tool work and ordinary output excluded equally. No model-quality or latency estimate.
Rates / million tokens: input $2 • cache read $0.10 • one-hour write $4 • output $10.
Precompact cost includes $0.01 warm input + $0.20 summary output + $0.08 new-prefix write.
Estimated, not measured; not subscription billing. If you never resume, precompaction spends $0.21 with no continuation benefit.
